name: aurum
description: Aurum Markets — gold-first forex/CFD broker platform (demo-first).

scripts.dev:docker: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev -w Backend" "npm run dev -w Frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w Backend && npm run build -w Frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w Backend && npm run typecheck -w Frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w Backend && npm run lint -w Frontend
